primary_sources.title: Neumann and Wightwick, Algorithms for polynomials in two variables, Section1 Theorem1.2 and strict normal forms
primary_sources.used_statement: Jung/van der Kulk generation and alternating triangular normal form, as recorded on page2; used only for the all-coordinate valuation proof.

primary_sources.title: Miyanishi, Lectures on Curves on Rational and Unirational Surfaces, TIFR60
primary_sources.used_statement: ChapterI Theorem4.1.1, printed page24 / PDF page40: affine faithfully flat A1 fibration over a locally factorial base is locally affine-line trivial; used for the reduced regular-coordinate sector.

primary_sources.title: Gwozdziewicz, Injectivity on one line, arXiv alg-geom/9305008v1 (1993)
primary_sources.used_statement: Theorem1.1: a complex polynomial Keller map injective on one affine line is an automorphism. Applied after source coordinate changes to force collisions on every source-coordinate line.
